applies_why: The judge text uses the open sense of the single verse Isaiah 7:14 as the ground for UNDERDETERMINED, which is the situation K-S2 governs.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] G answers the 'almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows, leaving the sign's sense open.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand. This is about one verse. It does not apply when the judge weighs two chains.
room: A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand. Readings: (1) the judge's sign's sense open is single-verse openness, forbidden; (2) it is two-chain weighing, outside K-S2. The text names one verse, Isaiah 7:14, so (1).
why: The judge's stated basis for UNDERDETERMINED is that the sign's sense remains open on Isaiah 7:14, which K-S2 forbids because a single verse with two senses is not open and both senses stand.
